svg.title: Photon shot noise at ArF and EUV doses
svg.desc: Two panels. Left: incident photons on a 20 nm by 20 nm area against dose, log scale; the ArF line sits about 14 times above the EUV line; at 30 mJ/cm² EUV gives 8,155 photons, at 50 mJ/cm² 13,592. Right: 3-sigma photon-count noise, 3.3 and 2.6 percent for EUV at those doses, under 1 percent for ArF.
svg.title: Photon shot noise at ArF and EUV doses
